name: Summon Flying Mount, Greater
body:
School conjuration (summoning); Level arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 8, cleric/oracle 8, druid 8, paladin 4, shaman 8, witch 8

Casting Time 1 round

Components V, S, DF

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Effect one summoned creature

Duration 1 round/level (D)

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

This spell functions like summon monster VIII, except it allows you to summon a single sleipnir, 1d3 dragon horses, or 1d4+1 kirin.
